build_create_dtd_data_files: build a python module to create DTD dataset files in VISSL-compatible classification format
run_create_dtd_cli: run the create_dtd_data_files CLI with input, output, and download flags to prepare the dataset
create_dtd_disk_folder: create a DTD disk folder by organizing images into train, val, test, and trainval splits
download_dtd_dataset: download and extract the Oxford DTD dataset archive to a specified root directory
cleanup_dtd_folders: cleanup downloaded DTD archives after converting data to VISSL-compatible format
